description: What a job pays. In the US: a metro area, state or the whole country, from the Bureau of Labor Statistics' Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics (May 2025, all industries): median yearly pay, the 10th to 90th percentile range and how many people do the job. Any other country: average monthly pay of employees by broad job group (managers, professionals, technicians, trades and more) in local currency, from the International Labour Organization's ILOSTAT. Use for job offers, salary negotiations, moving and career questions. Send the job title and a city, state (WA) or nothing for national. Not for inflation or what old dollars are worth (use check_inflation).

country.description: Country name or two-letter code; defaults to the United States

place.description: US only: city ('Seattle', 'Austin, TX'), state ('WA' or 'Washington'), or leave out for national

name: check_wage
title: Wage: what a job pays where you live
